en: A vintage black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a formally posed couple. The woman stands on the left in a light-colored, high‑waisted dress with layered necklaces and her hand resting on the man's shoulder. The man sits on the right in a dark naval or military-style uniform with epaulettes and decorative braid. Below the image there is printed text in Greek and French identifying them. The style is early‑20th‑century royal portraiture.
